title: SQL on FHIR benchmark schema
description: Inline benchmark file (authored intent only): a dataset recipe paired with ViewDefinition cases. Generated facts (expected row counts, dataset checksums) live in the sibling checkfile, not here.

name.description: Explicit dataset identity; the first on-disk dir segment.

version.description: Explicit, human-maintained dataset identity tag expressing INTENT to change the data; the second on-disk dir segment. Bumped deliberately when the recipe should re-generate. NOT a derived content hash.

syntheaVersion.description: The generator version pinned for this recipe, echoed into the checkfile's syntheaVersion for the lock. Distinct from the identity `version`.

id.description: Stable key (short, unique within the file, stable across edits). The checkfile's assertions and the report's per-case results reference this id, not the free-text title.

title.description: Free-text human label; may change freely.

countVariancePermitted.description: When true, this case's reference is resolved in `where`/`forEach` position where empty-vs-null-vs-error is engine-specific; the runner MUST NOT auto-flag a cross-engine count divergence as count_mismatch. The row-count-invariance claim holds only for projection-position references.

view.description: A ViewDefinition. Should conform to the ShareableViewDefinition profile so the case runs on strongly-typed engines: every column carries a `type`, and that `type` must match the FHIR type the column's path returns (e.g. a path ending in `.code` is `code`, not `string`).
